title: How to Choose a Teacher Training Institute in Chennai
metaDescription: A practical checklist for choosing a teacher training institute in Chennai — accreditation, practical training, fees, modes, certificates and career support compared.
intro: Choosing a teacher training institute in Chennai is not only about finding the nearest centre. The right programme should match your career goal, schedule, budget and the type of schools you want to work with. Use this checklist before you enrol.

sections.heading: What should you look for when choosing a teacher training institute?
sections.intro: Compare institutes against these criteria before you pay any fee.

items.detail: Check whether certificates are issued with a recognised affiliation number and whether the institute can show proof of affiliation.
items.spedics: We are affiliated with MMFRC (MARIA MONTESSORI FOUNDATION RESEARCH CENTRE). Our MMFRC Certification of Recognition is published on the website.

items.detail: Teacher training should include demonstrations, lesson planning practice and real classroom strategies — not only theory handouts.
items.spedics: We emphasise practical learning with classroom demonstrations, Montessori materials, phonics workshops and guided teaching practice.

items.detail: Ask for clear package options — certified vs diploma — with duration and total fee in writing.
items.spedics: Most courses offer Certified (3 months, ₹10,000) and Diploma (6 months, ₹15,000). Montessori also includes a PG Diploma (12 months, ₹35,000). Fees are listed on the website.

items.detail: Working teachers and homemakers often need flexible modes. Confirm whether live classes, recordings and in-person sessions are available.
items.spedics: We offer online, offline and hybrid modes across programmes.

items.detail: A good institute explains who can join, what documents are needed and which course fits your background.
items.spedics: Admission counselling is available by phone/WhatsApp at 7708743942. Eligibility is listed on each course page.

items.detail: If you prefer offline classes, consider travel time, parking and whether the centre is reachable from your area.
items.spedics: We are located at 4021, 6th Main Road, Ayapakkam, Chennai – 600077 — convenient for north Chennai areas including Ambattur, Avadi, Padi and Mogappair.

items.detail: Look for structured modules, assignments and mentor support — not just certificate issuance.
items.spedics: Programmes include module-wise learning, assessments and trainer guidance throughout the course.

sections.heading: Who can enrol?
items: Graduates and 10+2 pass students entering education careers
Existing preschool and primary teachers upgrading skills
Homemakers and parents moving into education roles
Career changers interested in Montessori, special education or school administration
Aspiring entrepreneurs planning a preschool or training centre

sections.heading: Questions to ask before you enrol
items: What certificate will I receive and who is the affiliating body?
Is the fee all-inclusive or are there extra charges for materials or exams?
Can I attend online if I miss an offline session?
How many classes per week and what is the total duration?
Will I get help with job applications or school interviews?
Can I visit the institute and speak with the admissions team first?

faqs.question: What qualification do I need for teacher training in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Most SPEDICS programmes require 10+2 or equivalent. Some advanced diplomas prefer graduates. Check the eligibility section on the specific course page.

faqs.question: Are online teacher training certificates valid?
faqs.answer: Validity depends on the affiliating body and the school employer. SPEDICS issues certificates with affiliation details for completed programmes. Always confirm requirements with your target employer.

faqs.question: How much does teacher training cost in Chennai?
faqs.answer: At SPEDICS, most courses are ₹10,000 (Certified, 3 months) or ₹15,000 (Diploma, 6 months). Language and phonics courses have separate fees listed on the website.
